title: Obtain and validate HW workforce data from all 8 states
Build the State → LGA → PHC segmentation tracker
Confirm baseline PHC universe (~1,560)
Map out Health Worker onboarding & training implementation plan
note: From the Week 1 status report — implementation approach mapped out.

title: Receive full LMS backend access from GGHN
note: Critical prerequisite — needed for FAQ, manual, content upload and analytics.

title: Conduct LMS technical/functional readiness review
Run HW/HF needs assessment (device, literacy, connectivity)
Document LMS capability gaps and manual workarounds
Receive List of Health Fellows (HFs) from NPHCDA
note: Critical prerequisite — HF training can't be scheduled until this arrives.

title: Recruit/confirm 156 HF/PFMOs (1 per LGA)
Schedule the HF Training session once the HF list is confirmed
note: Immediate next action once the List of Health Fellows arrives from NPHCDA — training can't be booked until then.

title: Deliver 2-day Train-the-Trainer session for HF/PFMOs
note: Walk HFs through the 12-step HW LMS journey (SMS invite → certificate download); cover common issues (forgotten passwords, registration errors, access problems) and the escalation protocol (HF resolves first; escalate to TLS + copy State Lead if unresolved within 1 hour). HFs leave with their field tools: HF/PFMO Reference Manual, tracker, daily reporting template.

title: Train State Leads on coordination & reporting role
Run competency assessment & certify HF/PFMOs (target ≥95%)
Finalize HF/PFMO Manual, LMS User Guide and FAQ
Finalize HF/PFMO Onboarding Tracker (5-sheet Excel tool)
Finalize escalation pathway card & daily reporting template
Receive full List of Health Workers (HWs) from NPHCDA
note: Critical prerequisite — needed to map HWs and select the pilot 5,000.

title: Map Health Workers to HF/LGA (workload assignment)
note: Each HF is assigned 1 PHC/day, up to 4 HWs per visit. Mapping identifies how many working days each HF needs and flags high-HW-density LGAs needing extra support — feeds directly into the HF/PFMO Onboarding Tracker (5-sheet Excel tool).

title: Finalize random selection — selected + reserve HWs per PHC
Outsourced Call Centre: verify HW details, pre-inform every worker
note: Verifies details, introduces the NPHCDA CPE programme, sets expectations. Wrong phone/name/facility flagged and corrected before the SMS goes out; unreachable workers escalated to the State Lead. Produces the clean, verified list Step 4 relies on.

title: Request bulk account creation from GGHN (5,000 accounts)
note: GGHN creates all 5,000 Moodle accounts (username format: firstname.surname) and returns credentials to TLS; TLS checks the list for completeness before the SMS step.

title: Send onboarding SMS (login details + welcome) to Health Workers
note: Personalised SMS with username, temporary password and platform link (learn.nphcda.gov.ng); explains the programme and that an HF will visit soon. Workers encouraged to save it before the HF arrives.

title: HF onboards HWs at PHC (1 facility/day, 4 HWs/visit)
note: HF guides the full registration/login process; supports or flags workers facing challenges (no smartphone, connectivity, low literacy); records progress in the Daily Onboarding sheet before leaving the facility.

title: Assign courses on LMS by language and cadre
note: 20 courses per language across 5 languages, all under Primary Healthcare Services. HF confirms the assigned courses are visible to the worker before leaving the facility.

title: Outsourced Call Centre: 48-hour check-in calls for HWs who haven't logged in
note: Follows up with any worker who hasn't logged in within 48 hours of onboarding to identify and resolve barriers.

title: Stay first point of technical contact for onboarded HWs
note: HFs remain the first point of contact for workers in their facilities; unresolved issues go directly to TLS within 1 hour.

title: Resolve technical issues within SLA
Run assisted/group sessions for low-literacy or low-connectivity clusters
Deploy reserve HWs to backfill drop-outs
Maintain central tracker/dashboard (daily refresh, weekly reconciliation)
note: HFs submit their Daily Onboarding sheet each evening; TLS reviews completion rates, issues and escalation flags across all LGAs.

title: Run platform analytics review (logins, course progress, assessment scores)
note: Use LMS backend access to monitor login frequency, course progression and assessment scores — and flag underperforming Health Workers.

title: Consolidate daily HF/PFMO and weekly State Lead reports
Conduct lessons-learned review
Produce final onboarding report for national scale-up
Hold first external stakeholder meeting with PHCSD
note: Aligned on project direction and next steps for implementation.

title: Recruit Programme Associate and Data Analyst
note: First-stage interviews completed.

title: Complete onboarding & induction schedule for new hires
Develop stakeholder engagement & mapping framework for rollout
Develop facilitator/trainer onboarding & logistics plan (8 states, 156 LGAs)
Stand up core project administration & reporting systems
Begin engagement with Lead Finance Team on budget monitoring
Management approval: priority office infrastructure & connectivity purchase
note: Requested 10 Aug — needed to unblock team mobilisation.

title: Management approval: onboarding budget & planning assumptions
note: Needed before detailed state-level costing and scheduling can proceed.

title: Provision core team tools (Teams, Power BI, OneDrive/SharePoint, WhatsApp)
Resolve Microsoft 365 access disruption from mailbox migration
Select and onboard an outsourced call centre vendor
note: TLS Call Desk functions (HW verification calls, 48-hour check-in follow-up) are planned to be outsourced to a third-party vendor rather than run in-house — vendor not yet selected.
